lines: A well. A slave market. A locked door. A prison. Years of waiting.
Every one of them was a step towards the throne.
Allah says at the end of this surah: "There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding."
So when your life feels like the bottom of a well... remember Yusuf. Patience is most fitting. And never despair of relief from Allah.
